objects.description: Enumeration of plot display formats used by Tracy to render plot values (number, memory, percentage, watt).
Severity levels for Tracy log/messages produced by the C API.
Opaque-ish handle to a profiling zone begun via the C API. Exposed to users as an immutable (conceptually const) context used to add metadata and to end the zone.
Opaque handle to a lockable context used by Tracy to instrument lock/unlock events in the C API. Only forward-declared here; owned/managed by the Tracy runtime.
Describes a static source location for zones/locks: optional name, function, file, line and color. Typically emitted as static storage used by macros.
GPU timing sample packet fields used by the C GPU instrumentation API.
Parameters used to start a GPU zone (by source-location id, GPU query id, and context).
Parameters used to start a GPU zone with an accompanying CPU callstack depth.
Parameters used to end a GPU zone (query id and context).
Description of a GPU context initialization, including current GPU time, timestamp period, id, flags, and backend type.
Packet for naming a GPU context (id, name pointer, and length).
Calibration data mapping GPU time to CPU time delta for a given context.
Packet for synchronizing GPU time in a context.

functions.name: ___tracy_set_thread_name
functions.description: Set the current thread's display name in the Tracy profiler UI. Typically called once at thread start.
requirements: name points to a valid, null-terminated C string.
May be called at any time; effective when the profiler is running/connected.

functions.name: ___tracy_startup_profiler
functions.description: Start the Tracy profiler manually when TRACY_MANUAL_LIFETIME is enabled.
requirements: Available only when TRACY_MANUAL_LIFETIME is defined at compile time.
Must be called before recording profiling events if manual lifetime is used.

functions.name: ___tracy_shutdown_profiler
functions.description: Shut down the Tracy profiler manually when TRACY_MANUAL_LIFETIME is enabled.
requirements: Available only when TRACY_MANUAL_LIFETIME is defined at compile time.
Should be called once after finishing profiling if manual lifetime is used.
Do not call profiling emit functions after shutdown.

functions.name: ___tracy_profiler_started
functions.description: Query whether the Tracy profiler has been started (manual lifetime mode). Returns non-zero if started.
requirements: Available only when TRACY_MANUAL_LIFETIME is defined at compile time.

functions.name: ___tracy_alloc_srcloc
functions.signature: TRACY_API uint64_t ___tracy_alloc_srcloc( uint32_t line, const char* source, size_t sourceSz, const char* function, size_t functionSz, uint32_t color );
functions.description: Allocate and return an interned source-location handle used for zones/events without static storage.
requirements: source points to a valid buffer of at least sourceSz bytes; contents should be a file path string.
function points to a valid buffer of at least functionSz bytes; contents should be a function name string.
color is an ARGB/RGBA 32-bit color value (library-defined).

functions.name: ___tracy_alloc_srcloc_name
functions.signature: TRACY_API uint64_t ___tracy_alloc_srcloc_name( uint32_t line, const char* source, size_t sourceSz, const char* function, size_t functionSz, const char* name, size_t nameSz, uint32_t color );
functions.description: Allocate and return an interned source-location handle with an associated custom name label.
requirements: source points to a valid buffer of at least sourceSz bytes.
function points to a valid buffer of at least functionSz bytes.
name points to a valid buffer of at least nameSz bytes.
color is a 32-bit color value.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_zone_begin
functions.signature: TRACY_API TracyCZoneCtx ___tracy_emit_zone_begin( const struct ___tracy_source_location_data* srcloc, int32_t active );
functions.description: Begin a profiling zone using a static source location. Returns a zone context to be passed to ___tracy_emit_zone_end and other zone APIs.
requirements: srcloc must point to a valid, initialized ___tracy_source_location_data.
active is typically 0 or 1; non-zero enables immediate recording.
The returned TracyCZoneCtx must be used with ___tracy_emit_zone_end exactly once.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_zone_begin_callstack
functions.signature: TRACY_API TracyCZoneCtx ___tracy_emit_zone_begin_callstack( const struct ___tracy_source_location_data* srcloc, int32_t depth, int32_t active );
functions.description: Begin a profiling zone and capture a callstack up to depth frames. Returns a zone context for subsequent operations.
requirements: srcloc must point to a valid ___tracy_source_location_data.
depth must be >= 0 (0 means no callstack).
active is typically 0 or 1.
End the returned context with ___tracy_emit_zone_end exactly once.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_zone_begin_alloc
functions.signature: TRACY_API TracyCZoneCtx ___tracy_emit_zone_begin_alloc( uint64_t srcloc, int32_t active );
functions.description: Begin a profiling zone using a previously allocated source-location handle from ___tracy_alloc_srcloc or ___tracy_alloc_srcloc_name.
requirements: srcloc is a handle returned by ___tracy_alloc_srcloc[ _name ].
active is typically 0 or 1.
End the returned context with ___tracy_emit_zone_end exactly once.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_zone_begin_alloc_callstack
functions.signature: TRACY_API TracyCZoneCtx ___tracy_emit_zone_begin_alloc_callstack( uint64_t srcloc, int32_t depth, int32_t active );
functions.description: Begin a profiling zone using an allocated source-location handle and capture a callstack of up to depth frames.
requirements: srcloc is a handle returned by ___tracy_alloc_srcloc[ _name ].
depth must be >= 0.
active is typically 0 or 1.
End the returned context with ___tracy_emit_zone_end exactly once.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_zone_end
functions.description: End a previously started profiling zone.
requirements: ctx must be a valid context returned by a matching ___tracy_emit_zone_begin* call that has not yet been ended.
Each zone must be ended exactly once.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_zone_text
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_emit_zone_text( TracyCZoneCtx ctx, const char* txt, size_t size );
functions.description: Attach an arbitrary text payload to an active zone.
requirements: ctx refers to an active zone not yet ended.
txt points to a buffer of at least size bytes; data need not be null-terminated.
size is the number of bytes to record; may be 0.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_zone_name
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_emit_zone_name( TracyCZoneCtx ctx, const char* txt, size_t size );
functions.description: Assign or update the display name of an active zone.
requirements: ctx refers to an active zone.
txt points to a buffer of at least size bytes.
size is the number of bytes to record.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_zone_color
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_emit_zone_color( TracyCZoneCtx ctx, uint32_t color );
functions.description: Set the display color of an active zone.
requirements: ctx refers to an active zone.
color is a 32-bit color value (library-defined format).

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_zone_value
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_emit_zone_value( TracyCZoneCtx ctx, uint64_t value );
functions.description: Attach a numeric value to an active zone, useful for timelines or gauges.
requirements: ctx refers to an active zone.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_gpu_zone_begin
functions.description: Begin a GPU profiling zone using the provided begin data (context, query id, and srcloc).
requirements: Parameter is a fully initialized ___tracy_gpu_zone_begin_data struct.
GPU context/query identifiers must be valid for the current GPU capture session.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_gpu_zone_begin_callstack
functions.description: Begin a GPU profiling zone and capture a callstack with a specified depth.
requirements: Parameter is a fully initialized ___tracy_gpu_zone_begin_callstack_data struct (srcloc, depth, queryId, context).
depth must be >= 0.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_gpu_zone_begin_alloc
functions.description: Begin a GPU profiling zone using an allocated source-location handle.
requirements: Parameter is a fully initialized ___tracy_gpu_zone_begin_data struct.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_gpu_zone_begin_alloc_callstack
functions.description: Begin a GPU profiling zone with an allocated srcloc and callstack capture.
requirements: Parameter is a fully initialized ___tracy_gpu_zone_begin_callstack_data struct.
depth must be >= 0.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_gpu_zone_end
functions.description: End a GPU profiling zone for a given context/query.
requirements: data contains a valid queryId and GPU context matching a prior begin.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_gpu_time
functions.description: Send a GPU timestamp sample for a specific context/query.
requirements: Parameter is a valid ___tracy_gpu_time_data with gpuTime in profiler's expected time units and valid context/queryId.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_gpu_new_context
functions.description: Declare a new GPU profiling context with timing period, flags, and type.
requirements: Parameter is a valid ___tracy_gpu_new_context_data with correct period and identifiers.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_gpu_context_name
functions.description: Assign a human-readable name to a GPU profiling context.
requirements: Parameter is a valid ___tracy_gpu_context_name_data; name points to a buffer of at least len bytes.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_gpu_calibration
functions.description: Provide calibration data to correlate GPU and CPU timelines.
requirements: Parameter is a valid ___tracy_gpu_calibration_data with appropriate timestamps and context.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_gpu_time_sync
functions.description: Provide a GPU time sample to synchronize clocks without a corresponding query.
requirements: Parameter is a valid ___tracy_gpu_time_sync_data.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_gpu_zone_begin_serial
functions.description: Begin a GPU zone in a serialized/explicit submission mode.
requirements: Parameter is a fully initialized ___tracy_gpu_zone_begin_data struct.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_gpu_zone_begin_callstack_serial
functions.description: Begin a GPU zone with callstack capture in serialized mode.
requirements: Parameter is a fully initialized ___tracy_gpu_zone_begin_callstack_data struct.
depth must be >= 0.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_gpu_zone_begin_alloc_serial
functions.description: Begin a GPU zone (allocated srcloc) in serialized mode.
requirements: Parameter is a fully initialized ___tracy_gpu_zone_begin_data struct.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_gpu_zone_begin_alloc_callstack_serial
functions.description: Begin a GPU zone (allocated srcloc) with callstack capture in serialized mode.
requirements: Parameter is a fully initialized ___tracy_gpu_zone_begin_callstack_data struct.
depth must be >= 0.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_gpu_zone_end_serial
functions.description: End a GPU zone in serialized mode.
requirements: data contains a valid queryId and context matching a prior serialized begin.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_gpu_time_serial
functions.description: Send a serialized GPU timestamp sample.
requirements: Parameter is a valid ___tracy_gpu_time_data.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_gpu_new_context_serial
functions.description: Declare a new GPU context in serialized mode.
requirements: Parameter is a valid ___tracy_gpu_new_context_data.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_gpu_context_name_serial
functions.description: Name a GPU context in serialized mode.
requirements: Parameter is a valid ___tracy_gpu_context_name_data; name buffer is at least len bytes.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_gpu_calibration_serial
functions.description: Send GPU/CPU calibration data in serialized mode.
requirements: Parameter is a valid ___tracy_gpu_calibration_data.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_gpu_time_sync_serial
functions.description: Send GPU time sync sample in serialized mode.
requirements: Parameter is a valid ___tracy_gpu_time_sync_data.

functions.name: ___tracy_connected
functions.description: Return non-zero if the profiler is connected to a client; zero otherwise.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_memory_alloc
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_emit_memory_alloc( const void* ptr, size_t size, int32_t secure );
functions.description: Record a memory allocation event for the given pointer and size.
requirements: ptr is the allocated block address; may be nullptr only if the allocator semantics produce null allocations (not typical).
size is the allocation size in bytes.
secure is 0 for normal, 1 for secure memory (affects how data is handled).

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_memory_alloc_callstack
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_emit_memory_alloc_callstack( const void* ptr, size_t size, int32_t depth, int32_t secure );
functions.description: Record a memory allocation event with a captured callstack.
requirements: ptr is the allocated address.
size is in bytes.
depth >= 0.
secure is 0 or 1.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_memory_free
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_emit_memory_free( const void* ptr, int32_t secure );
functions.description: Record a memory free event for the given pointer.
requirements: ptr is the address being freed; should match a prior allocation event.
secure is 0 or 1 and should match the allocation if applicable.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_memory_free_callstack
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_emit_memory_free_callstack( const void* ptr, int32_t depth, int32_t secure );
functions.description: Record a memory free event with a captured callstack.
requirements: ptr is the address being freed.
depth >= 0.
secure is 0 or 1.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_memory_alloc_named
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_emit_memory_alloc_named( const void* ptr, size_t size, int32_t secure, const char* name );
functions.description: Record a memory allocation event and tag it with a name.
requirements: ptr is the allocated address.
size is in bytes.
secure is 0 or 1.
name points to a null-terminated string identifying the allocation group.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_memory_alloc_callstack_named
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_emit_memory_alloc_callstack_named( const void* ptr, size_t size, int32_t depth, int32_t secure, const char* name );
functions.description: Record a named memory allocation with a captured callstack.
requirements: ptr is the allocated address.
size is in bytes.
depth >= 0.
secure is 0 or 1.
name points to a null-terminated string.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_memory_free_named
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_emit_memory_free_named( const void* ptr, int32_t secure, const char* name );
functions.description: Record a named memory free event.
requirements: ptr is the address being freed.
secure is 0 or 1.
name points to the tag used for the allocation (null-terminated).

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_memory_free_callstack_named
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_emit_memory_free_callstack_named( const void* ptr, int32_t depth, int32_t secure, const char* name );
functions.description: Record a named memory free event with a captured callstack.
requirements: ptr is the address being freed.
depth >= 0.
secure is 0 or 1.
name points to a null-terminated string.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_memory_discard
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_emit_memory_discard( const char* name, int32_t secure );
functions.description: Record a memory discard event for a named region/group (no pointer).
requirements: name points to a null-terminated string identifying the region.
secure is 0 or 1.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_memory_discard_callstack
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_emit_memory_discard_callstack( const char* name, int32_t secure, int32_t depth );
functions.description: Record a memory discard event with a captured callstack.
requirements: name points to a null-terminated string identifying the region.
secure is 0 or 1.
depth >= 0.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_logString
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_emit_logString( int8_t severity, int32_t color, int32_t callstack_depth, size_t size, const char* txt );
functions.description: Emit a log message with explicit size and optional color and callstack capture.
requirements: severity is an enum-like value (see TracyMessageSeverity).
color is a 32-bit color or 0 for default.
callstack_depth >= 0.
txt points to a buffer of at least size bytes; may contain binary; not required to be null-terminated.
size is the number of bytes to record.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_logStringL
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_emit_logStringL( int8_t severity, int32_t color, int32_t callstack_depth, const char* txt );
functions.description: Emit a null-terminated log message; size is determined by strlen on the profiler side.
requirements: severity is an enum-like value (see TracyMessageSeverity).
color is a 32-bit color or 0 for default.
callstack_depth >= 0.
txt points to a valid null-terminated C string.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_frame_mark
functions.description: Insert a frame marker, optionally named, to delimit frames or phases.
requirements: name may be NULL for an unnamed frame stream or points to a null-terminated string to identify a specific frame stream.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_frame_mark_start
functions.description: Mark the start of a named frame stream for manual frame timing.
requirements: name points to a null-terminated string identifying the stream (should match the end call).

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_frame_mark_end
functions.description: Mark the end of a named frame stream for manual frame timing.
requirements: name points to a null-terminated string matching a prior start marker.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_frame_image
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_emit_frame_image( const void* image, uint16_t w, uint16_t h, uint8_t offset, int32_t flip );
functions.description: Send a frame image (e.g., screenshot/thumbnail) to the profiler.
requirements: image points to a valid pixel buffer large enough for the specified dimensions and format expected by Tracy.
w and h are image width and height in pixels.
offset is an implementation-defined row offset/stride parameter (library-defined).
flip indicates vertical flip (non-zero to flip).

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_plot
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_emit_plot( const char* name, double val );
functions.description: Submit a numeric data point (double) to a named plot series.
requirements: name points to a null-terminated string identifying the series.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_plot_float
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_emit_plot_float( const char* name, float val );
functions.description: Submit a numeric data point (float) to a named plot series.
requirements: name points to a null-terminated string identifying the series.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_plot_int
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_emit_plot_int( const char* name, int64_t val );
functions.description: Submit a numeric data point (integer) to a named plot series.
requirements: name points to a null-terminated string identifying the series.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_plot_config
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_emit_plot_config( const char* name, int32_t type, int32_t step, int32_t fill, uint32_t color );
functions.description: Configure how a named plot series is displayed (format, step/line mode, fill, color).
requirements: name points to a null-terminated string identifying the series.
type is a plot format (use TracyPlotFormatEnum values).
step and fill are boolean-like integers (0/1 semantics).
color is a 32-bit color value.

functions.name: ___tracy_emit_message_appinfo
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_emit_message_appinfo( const char* txt, size_t size );
functions.description: Send application info text to be displayed in the profiler.
requirements: txt points to a buffer of at least size bytes (not required to be null-terminated).
size is the number of bytes to record.

functions.name: ___tracy_announce_lockable_ctx
functions.description: Announce a lockable object to the profiler and obtain a lock context handle for subsequent lock/unlock events.
requirements: srcloc points to a valid ___tracy_source_location_data describing the lock site/context.
Return value must be stored and reused for subsequent lock events on the same lockable.

functions.name: ___tracy_terminate_lockable_ctx
functions.description: Terminate a previously announced lockable context.
requirements: lockdata must be a valid pointer previously returned by ___tracy_announce_lockable_ctx and not already terminated.

functions.name: ___tracy_before_lock_lockable_ctx
functions.description: Notify the profiler prior to attempting to acquire a lock; may return a non-zero flag to indicate further tracking.
requirements: lockdata is a valid lock context returned by ___tracy_announce_lockable_ctx.

functions.name: ___tracy_after_lock_lockable_ctx
functions.description: Notify the profiler after successfully acquiring a lock.
requirements: lockdata is a valid lock context returned by ___tracy_announce_lockable_ctx.

functions.name: ___tracy_after_unlock_lockable_ctx
functions.description: Notify the profiler after releasing a lock.
requirements: lockdata is a valid lock context returned by ___tracy_announce_lockable_ctx.

functions.name: ___tracy_after_try_lock_lockable_ctx
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_after_try_lock_lockable_ctx( struct __tracy_lockable_context_data* lockdata, int32_t acquired );
functions.description: Notify the profiler after a try_lock attempt, indicating whether the lock was acquired.
requirements: lockdata is a valid lock context.
acquired should be 0 if the try_lock failed, non-zero if it succeeded.

functions.name: ___tracy_mark_lockable_ctx
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_mark_lockable_ctx( struct __tracy_lockable_context_data* lockdata, const struct ___tracy_source_location_data* srcloc );
functions.description: Mark a code location related to a lockable (e.g., contention site).
requirements: lockdata is a valid lock context.
srcloc points to a valid ___tracy_source_location_data.

functions.name: ___tracy_custom_name_lockable_ctx
functions.signature: TRACY_API void ___tracy_custom_name_lockable_ctx( struct __tracy_lockable_context_data* lockdata, const char* name, size_t nameSz );
functions.description: Assign a custom name to a lockable context for display in the profiler.
requirements: lockdata is a valid lock context.
name points to a buffer of at least nameSz bytes; not required to be null-terminated.
nameSz is the number of bytes to record.

functions.name: ___tracy_begin_sampling_profiler
functions.description: Begin CPU sampling profiler capture, if supported. Returns non-zero on success.

functions.name: ___tracy_end_sampling_profiler
functions.description: End an active CPU sampling profiler capture.
requirements: Should be paired with a preceding successful ___tracy_begin_sampling_profiler call.

functions.name: ___tracy_fiber_enter
functions.description: Mark the current thread as entering a fiber with the given name (fiber-aware profiling).
requirements: Available only when TRACY_FIBERS is defined at compile time.
fiber points to a null-terminated string identifying the fiber.

functions.name: ___tracy_fiber_leave
functions.description: Mark the current thread as leaving the current fiber.
requirements: Available only when TRACY_FIBERS is defined at compile time.
Should follow a prior ___tracy_fiber_enter for the same thread.

generators.generator:
import random
import string
from typing import List

# This generator produces valid null-terminated C strings intended for FUZZ_PARAM_STR
# in the ___tracy_set_thread_name fuzzer stub. The bytes returned will be interpreted
# by the harness as the backing buffer for a std::string and then exposed via c_str(),
# so we ensure the content is a reasonable thread name and contains no embedded NULs,
# with an explicit terminating NUL at the end. We include a variety of interesting,
# but valid names to exercise different code paths and UI behaviors: ASCII, UTF-8,
# long names near typical UI limits, names with spaces, punctuation, emoji, and
# different case patterns.

MAX_TOTAL_SIZE = 4096

# Some curated interesting thread names (without NUL terminators)
CURATED_NAMES: List[str] = [
    "main",
    "worker",
    "io-thread",
    "render",
    "RenderThread#1",
    "Thread-0001",
    "THREAD_UPPERCASE",
    "thread_lowercase",
    "MiXeD_CaSe_Thread",
    "thread with spaces",
    "tab\tinside",
    "newline\ninside",
    "unicode-äöü-ß",
    "emoji-😀",
    "日本語スレッド",
    "русский_поток",
    "الخيـط",
    "very-very-very-long-thread-name-but-still-valid",
    "GPU0-queue:compute",
    "GPU1-queue:graphics",
    "Net/Recv",
    "Net/Send",
    "Audio[Mix]",
    "Physics@Step",
    "IO::Disk",
    "db-worker:read-only",
    "db-worker:write",
    "Background#A",
    "Background#B",
    "FrameBuilder(Stage2)",
]

# Allowed characters for random ASCII names (exclude NUL).
ASCII_POOL = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "-_ ./:@[]()#"  # valid, visible chars

# Some UTF-8 snippets to mix into names
UTF8_SNIPPETS = [
    "😀", "🚀", "🐍", "💾", "🔥", "ä", "ö", "ü", "ß", "é", "ñ",
    "日本", "語", "线程", "рус", "кий", "Δ", "π", "λ", "Ω",
]


def _rand_ascii_name(rng: random.Random, min_len: int = 1, max_len: int = 64) -> str:
    n = rng.randint(min_len, max_len)
    return ''.join(rng.choice(ASCII_POOL) for _ in range(n))


def _rand_utf8_name(rng: random.Random, min_len: int = 1, max_len: int = 48) -> str:
    # Compose with ASCII base and inject some UTF-8 snippets
    base = _rand_ascii_name(rng, 0, max(0, max_len - 8))
    parts = [base]
    k = rng.randint(1, 4)
    for _ in range(k):
        parts.append(rng.choice(UTF8_SNIPPETS))
        if rng.random() < 0.6:
            parts.append(_rand_ascii_name(rng, 0, 8))
    name = ''.join(parts)
    if len(name) == 0:
        name = rng.choice(UTF8_SNIPPETS)
    return name[:max_len]


def _long_name(rng: random.Random, target_len: int = 200) -> str:
    # Build a long, but reasonable thread name
    segments = [
        "long", "thread", "name", "segment", "part", "stage", "module",
        "worker", "queue", "pipeline", "task", "unit",
    ]
    sep = rng.choice(["-", "_", "/", ":", "."])
    s = []
    while len(sep.join(s)) < target_len:
        word = rng.choice(segments)
        if rng.random() < 0.3:
            word += str(rng.randint(0, 9999))
        s.append(word)
    name = sep.join(s)
    return name[:target_len]


def _choose_name(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    choice = rng.random()
    if choice < 0.25:
        return rng.choice(CURATED_NAMES)
    elif choice < 0.55:
        return _rand_ascii_name(rng)
    elif choice < 0.85:
        return _rand_utf8_name(rng)
    else:
        return _long_name(rng, target_len=rng.randint(80, 512))


def _ensure_no_nul(s: str) -> str:
    # Remove any accidental NULs (unlikely in Python str, but be safe if constructed from bytes)
    return s.replace("\x00", "")


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    name = _choose_name(rng)
    name = _ensure_no_nul(name)

    # Clamp total size to MAX_TOTAL_SIZE-1 for the trailing NUL terminator.
    encoded = name.encode('utf-8', errors='strict')
    if len(encoded) + 1 > MAX_TOTAL_SIZE:
        # Truncate by code points to avoid splitting multibyte sequences.
        # Walk and accumulate until limit.
        out_bytes = bytearray()
        for ch in name:
            cb = ch.encode('utf-8')
            if len(out_bytes) + len(cb) + 1 > MAX_TOTAL_SIZE:
                break
            out_bytes.extend(cb)
        encoded = bytes(out_bytes)

    # Append explicit NUL terminator to make it a C string in the fuzz buffer.
    return encoded + b"\x00"
